content.stem: 一家银行已加入一项公私合作伙伴关系（PPP）计划，与执法部门和监管机构合作打击金融犯罪。然而，该银行的数据保护官担心共享敏感客户数据，合规官也担心可能无法及时从政府获得有用信息。以下哪一项最能描述公私合作伙伴关系（PPP）在打击金融犯罪方面的益处？

options.A: 公私合作伙伴关系通过银行与执法部门之间共享情报，提高了金融犯罪的侦测和预防能力
options.B: 公私合作伙伴关系通过自动化信息共享帮助银行降低合规成本
options.C: 公私合作伙伴关系使银行能够自行管理可疑活动报告（SAR）的提交流程，而无需涉及金融情报机构（FIU）
options.D: 通过提供执法部门的实时情报，公私合作伙伴关系能够最大限度提高银行合规计划的效率

content.stem_en: A bank has joined a public-private partnership (PPP) to work with law enforcement and regulators on combating financial crime. However, the bank's data protection officer is concerned about sharing sensitive customer data, and the compliance officer is worried about potential delays in receiving useful information from the government. Which of the following best describes a benefit of PPPs in fighting financial crime?

options_en.A: PPPs improve financial crime detection and prevention by sharing intelligence between banks and law enforcement
options_en.B: PPPs help banks reduce compliance costs by automating information sharing
options_en.C: PPPs allow banks to manage their own suspicious activity report (SAR) filing process without the need to involve the Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU)
options_en.D: PPPs maximize the efficiency of the bank's compliance program by providing real-time intelligence from law enforcement
